products.name: Advanced Technology Solutions
products.description: A suite of technology-driven services including Data and AI, Digital Technology, Advisory Services, and Agentic Solutions, delivered through proprietary and partner technologies to transform business processes for clients. These solutions are developed and implemented using a mix of in-house and third-party AI, machine learning, and automation tools.

products.name: Core Business Services
products.description: Comprehensive business process outsourcing and managed services, including Decision Support Services, Technology Services, and Digital Operations, delivered through a global network of delivery centers and leveraging both human expertise and digital technologies.

products.name: Finance and Accounting Services
products.description: End-to-end finance and accounting outsourcing services, including accounts payable, invoice-to-cash, record to report, financial planning and analysis, enterprise risk and compliance, and finance strategy, delivered through process expertise and digital tools.

products.name: Supply Chain and Procurement Services
products.description: Advisory and managed services for supply chain and procurement operations, covering the full value chain from planning to aftersales, including supply chain resiliency, sustainable supply chain, strategic sourcing, category management, and procurement operations, enabled by technology and process transformation.

products.name: Human Resources and People Advisory Services
products.description: Consulting and managed services for HR transformation, including change management, HR operating model design, technology implementation, and M&A people integration, delivered through strategic communications, leadership enablement, and training design.

products.name: Sales, Commercial, Marketing and Experience Services
products.description: Services to transform and manage the end-to-end sales lifecycle, marketing, and customer experience, including campaign management, lead generation, pricing optimization, B2B customer experience, and generative AI-enabled experience transformation, leveraging data, technology, and process design.

products.name: Global Business Solutions / Global Capability Center Services
products.description: Advisory and implementation services to help clients set up and optimize their own global business solutions or capability centers, including strategy, location selection, operating model design, hiring, transition, and service delivery optimization.

products.name: Industry-Specific Operations and Analytics Services
products.description: Domain-specific business process and analytics services tailored to industries such as financial services, insurance, consumer goods, healthcare, high tech, and manufacturing, including customer onboarding, claims management, regulatory affairs, supply chain management, and trust and safety operations.

products.name: Manufactured Home Community Site Leasing
products.description: Leasing of developed sites within owned communities to customers who own manufactured homes or cottages, typically on a month-to-month or annual basis. This is a real estate rental business requiring property ownership, site development, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Recreational Vehicle (RV) Community Site Leasing
products.description: Leasing of sites within owned communities to customers with recreational vehicles, on both short-term and long-term bases. This involves property ownership, site development, and management of amenities and infrastructure for RV users.

products.name: Marina Slip and Storage Leasing
products.description: Rental of boat slips and dry storage spaces at owned marinas to boat owners. This requires ownership and operation of marina infrastructure and provision of related amenities and services.

products.name: Membership Campground Subscriptions
products.description: Sale of right-to-use or membership subscriptions that grant customers access to specific properties (primarily campgrounds) for limited stays, often under the Thousand Trails brand. This is a subscription-based service model leveraging owned real estate and amenities.

products.name: Factory-Built Home Sales and Leasing
products.description: Sale and leasing of factory-built homes (manufactured homes and cottages) located within company-owned properties, including brokerage services for residents wishing to sell their homes. This involves inventory management, sales operations, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Ancillary Property Amenities and Services
products.description: Provision of amenities and services at properties, such as golf courses, pro shops, stores, restaurants, laundry facilities, cable television, internet, and utilities. These are offered as value-added services to residents and guests, sometimes for additional fees.

products.name: Rinvatercept (KER-065)
products.description: A protein therapeutic (ligand trap) designed to inhibit TGF-ß ligands such as myostatin and activin A, developed for the treatment of neuromuscular diseases including Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It is produced via recombinant protein engineering and delivered as a subcutaneous injection.

products.name: Elritercept (KER-050)
products.description: An engineered ligand trap targeting TGF-ß signaling pathways, designed to increase red blood cell and platelet production by promoting hematopoiesis. Developed for the treatment of cytopenias (anemia and thrombocytopenia) in patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) and myelofibrosis. Manufactured as a recombinant fusion protein and administered via injection.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics (Voruciclib and Zandelisib)
products.description: Development and commercialization of novel oral cancer therapies, including voruciclib (a CDK9 inhibitor) and zandelisib (a PI3Kδ inhibitor), produced through pharmaceutical R&D, clinical trials, and regulatory approval processes. These are manufactured via contract manufacturing and delivered as oral medications for cancer treatment.

products.name: Out-Licensing and Strategic Partnerships for Drug Candidates
products.description: Out-licensing of drug candidates and entering into strategic partnerships for further development and commercialization by third parties, leveraging proprietary compounds and intellectual property. Revenue is generated through licensing agreements, milestone payments, and royalties.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Management (Litecoin Treasury Strategy)
products.description: Deployment of company capital into digital assets, specifically Litecoin (LTC), as a primary reserve asset, managed through agreements with asset managers and custodians. This is a financial strategy leveraging digital asset infrastructure rather than a traditional product or service, but may expand to include related activities such as Litecoin mining.

products.name: Mortgage-Backed Securities Investment
products.description: The company acquires and manages mortgage-backed securities (MBS) as its primary business, generating returns through investment in these financial assets. This business line requires significant financial capital and expertise in mortgage finance, and is delivered through capital markets transactions rather than physical products or in-person services.

products.name: Specialty Equipment Rental
products.description: Rental of a large fleet of specialty equipment such as bucket trucks, digger derricks, cranes, rail trucks, vacuum trucks, and other vehicles primarily for electric utility, telecom, rail, and infrastructure end-markets. Equipment is physically manufactured or customized and delivered to customers for temporary use.

products.name: New and Used Specialty Equipment Sales
products.description: Sale of new and used specialty trucks and equipment, including highly customized vehicles, to customers in infrastructure-related industries. Equipment is produced or sourced, often customized, and sold directly to end users.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts, Tools, and Accessories Sales and Rental
products.description: Provision of a comprehensive range of aftermarket parts, tools, and accessories for specialty equipment, available for purchase or rental. Includes insulated tools, stringing blocks, augers, and other specialized items, distributed through dedicated locations and packaged kits.

products.name: Test and Repair Services
products.description: Testing, inspection, and repair services for specialty equipment, tools, and personal protective equipment to ensure regulatory compliance and operational safety. Services are provided at certified labs and repair facilities nationwide.

products.name: Upfit and Customization Services
products.description: Customization and upfitting of heavy-duty trucks and specialty equipment to meet specific customer requirements, including adding features and modifying vehicles for unique job demands. Delivered through integrated production and customization operations.

products.name: Cross-Border Freight Forwarding Services
products.description: Provision of customized cross-border ocean and air freight consolidation and forwarding services, acting as a licensed NVOCC and indirect air carrier, collaborating with global carriers to transport goods from Asia into the U.S. This service requires regulatory compliance, coordination with carriers, and logistics expertise.

products.name: Customs Clearance Services
products.description: Customs clearance services provided in conjunction with freight forwarding, including preparation and filing of required documentation, calculation and payment of duties, taxes, and arranging for inspections. Delivered through collaboration with licensed customs brokerage experts and integrated into the logistics process.

products.name: Warehousing and Distribution Services
products.description: Ancillary warehousing and distribution services for cross-border freight, including storage, fulfillment, transloading, palletizing, packaging, and distribution, operated through regional warehousing centers in Illinois and Texas and a network of partner facilities. Requires physical infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: U.S. Domestic Ground Transportation Services
products.description: Full-truckload and less-than-truckload ground transportation of cross-border freight within the U.S., delivered either directly from port to door or from warehousing centers to domestic addresses, using an extensive network of transportation service providers.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution Services
products.description: Comprehensive pharmaceutical distribution and supply chain services in China, including ordering, purchasing, and delivering pharmaceutical products (notably infusion fluids) from manufacturers to various customers, requiring specialized licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Utility Infrastructure Construction and Maintenance Services
products.description: Construction, maintenance, replacement, and engineering services for natural gas and electric utility distribution and transmission systems, as well as communications systems. Delivered through skilled labor and equipment-intensive operations, often under multi-year Master Service Agreements or project contracts.

products.name: Energy Infrastructure Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Services
products.description: Engineering, procurement, construction, and maintenance services for energy, renewable energy and energy storage, renewable fuels, and petroleum and petrochemical industries, as well as transportation agencies. Services are project-based and require specialized technical expertise and equipment.

products.name: Renewable Energy Infrastructure Services
products.description: Construction and related services for solar facilities and other renewable energy infrastructure, including engineering and installation for solar facility developers and power producers. Delivered through project contracts and requires specialized labor and equipment.

products.name: Transportation Infrastructure Construction Services
products.description: Construction and maintenance services for transportation infrastructure, including projects for state departments of transportation. Delivered through large-scale project contracts requiring heavy equipment and skilled labor.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Traditional banking products and services including checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and consumer loans, delivered through a network of physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels such as mobile and online banking.

products.name: Private Banking Services
products.description: Personalized banking and financial services tailored to high-net-worth individuals and their businesses, provided primarily through dedicated private bank branches and relationship managers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A range of lending products for businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, originated nationally to middle-market and mid-sized companies, requiring significant underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including multi-family, office, retail, and industrial properties, primarily in the Northeast and Midwest, involving collateral evaluation and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: A variety of deposit products for consumers and businesses, such as checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, supported by FDIC insurance and accessible via branches, ATMs, and digital platforms.

products.name: Non-Deposit Investment Products and Insurance
products.description: Investment and insurance products offered to customers, including brokerage and investment advisory services, delivered through a regulated subsidiary and branch network.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination, processing, and servicing of residential mortgage loans, subject to federal and state regulations, with activities including underwriting, compliance, and loan sales to secondary markets.

products.name: Medicare Advantage Plans
products.description: Private health insurance plans for seniors, offering coverage for hospital, physician, and prescription drug services, as well as supplemental benefits like dental, vision, and fitness. These plans are managed and administered by Alignment, which contracts with CMS and delivers care through a network of providers and in-house clinical teams.

products.name: Care Anywhere Program (In-Home and Virtual Care Management)
products.description: A proactive, clinician-driven care management service for high-risk and chronically ill members, delivered through in-home visits and virtual consultations by Alignment-employed clinical teams. This service includes personalized care plans, 24/7 access, and coordination of medical, social, and behavioral health needs.

products.name: Supplemental Benefits for Seniors
products.description: A suite of additional services offered to Medicare Advantage members, including dental, vision, gym access, fitness programs, caregiver support, and non-emergency transportation, designed to enhance quality of life and support overall wellness.

products.name: 24/7 Concierge Member Services
products.description: A round-the-clock support service for members, providing assistance with care navigation, benefits, and access to clinical and non-clinical resources via phone and digital channels. Delivered through in-house call centers and digital platforms.

products.name: BB-301 (Silence and Replace-Based Gene Therapy for OPMD)
products.description: BB-301 is an AAV-based gene therapy developed using the proprietary 'silence and replace' approach, designed for the treatment of Oculopharyngeal Muscular Dystrophy (OPMD). It is manufactured using modified AAV9 viral vectors to deliver a bifunctional genetic construct that both silences the mutant PABPN1 gene and replaces it with a codon-optimized wildtype gene, administered via a proprietary injection method to the pharyngeal muscle. The product is delivered as a single localized administration and requires complex biological manufacturing processes.

products.name: Fire Inhibitor Chemicals
products.description: Environmentally sustainable, water-based fire inhibitor formulations (liquid and dry powder) used for fire suppression and prevention, manufactured under proprietary chemistry and shipped directly to customers for application on structures, vegetation, and ground surfaces.

products.name: Fire-Protected Wood Products
products.description: Class A fire-rated lumber and engineered wood products treated with CitroTech fire inhibitor chemistry in factory-controlled processes, sold to lumber and building material companies for use in construction and building materials.

products.name: Proactive Wildfire Defense Systems (CitroSafe Systems)
products.description: Self-contained, remotely activated sprinkler systems installed on residential and commercial properties, utilizing CitroTech fire inhibitor to create fire protection zones; includes system installation and ongoing support, with integration of wireless communication and GPS tracking.

products.name: Wildfire Defense Network Services
products.description: Subscription-based services for fire departments and municipalities, providing GPS-tracked, wireless network-coordinated wildfire defense operations, including mapping, monitoring, and documentation of fire protection zones at neighborhood and community scale.

products.name: Automobile Financing Programs
products.description: Provides indirect automobile financing to consumers, primarily those with impaired or limited credit histories, through a nationwide network of automobile dealers. Financing is delivered via two main programs: the Portfolio Program (advances to dealers secured by future loan collections) and the Purchase Program (outright purchase of consumer loans from dealers). Requires significant financial capital, proprietary credit scoring, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Loan Servicing and Collections
products.description: Services and collects payments on consumer automobile loans, including early-stage delinquency management, repossession coordination, and deficiency collections. Delivered through a dedicated servicing platform and in-house representatives, with some activities outsourced to third-party providers. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person labor.

products.name: Vehicle Service Contract Reinsurance
products.description: Reinsures vehicle service contracts sold to consumers by dealers, covering repair or replacement costs for mechanical failures. Delivered through a wholly owned subsidiary (VSC Re) and involves managing trust accounts to fund claims. Requires insurance expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Ancillary Automotive Protection Products Administration
products.description: Provides administration and profit-sharing for ancillary products such as vehicle service contracts and Guaranteed Asset Protection (GAP) offered through third-party providers. Involves collecting administrative fees and sharing profits with dealers. Requires digital administration and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Automobile Loan Origination Platform
products.description: Offers a proprietary digital platform (CAPS) and integrations for dealers to submit consumer credit applications, receive approvals, and generate compliant loan documents. Delivered as a digital service to dealers nationwide, leveraging proprietary credit scoring and automated decisioning.

products.name: Protective Communications Software Platform (Genasys Protect)
products.description: A cloud-based, modular SaaS platform that integrates real-time data from sensors and IoT devices to enable multichannel emergency alerting, mass notification, evacuation planning, and critical event management for government, education, and enterprise customers. Delivered digitally and operated via a unified dashboard, it supports integration with physical and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Cross-Agency Collaboration Platform (Genasys Evertel)
products.description: A secure, CJIS-compliant digital collaboration and messaging platform for first responders and public safety agencies, enabling real-time, encrypted communication and information sharing across agencies, with compliance features for record retention and privacy. Delivered as a software solution, often integrated with other Genasys platforms.

products.name: Mass Notification Speaker Systems (Genasys Acoustics)
products.description: Physically manufactured, networked outdoor and indoor speaker systems capable of broadcasting highly intelligible voice messages and alert tones over large areas, with options for solar power, battery backup, and satellite connectivity. Integrated with command-and-control software for remote activation and operation, designed for emergency warning and public address.

products.name: Long Range Acoustic Devices (LRAD)
products.description: Proprietary, physically manufactured acoustic hailing devices capable of projecting focused, high-clarity voice messages and alert tones over distances up to 5,000 meters. Used for defense, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and public safety applications, with various models and accessories for different operational needs.

products.name: Integrated National Emergency Warning System (NEWS)
products.description: A software-based solution that partners with national governments and mobile telecom networks to deliver geo-targeted SMS and cell broadcast alerts to the public without opt-in, registration, or downloads. Delivered as a digital service integrated with mobile carrier infrastructure.

products.name: Repair, Maintenance, and Extended Warranty Services
products.description: Aftermarket service agreements providing repair, maintenance, and extended warranty coverage for Genasys hardware products, offered at market rates for terms ranging from one to several years. Delivered through direct service or third-party arrangements.

products.name: Ferrous and Nonferrous Scrap Metal
products.description: Processed and recycled ferrous and nonferrous scrap metals are collected at recycling facilities using specialized shredding and separation equipment, then sold to external steel mills, foundries, and other metal manufacturers. This is a physical, logistics-intensive business requiring significant infrastructure.

products.name: Long Steel Products (Rebar, Merchant Bar, Wire Rod, Structural Sections, Billets)
products.description: Manufactured in electric arc furnace (EAF) mini and micro mills, these finished and semi-finished steel products are rolled, shaped, and prepared for shipment to construction, manufacturing, and distribution customers. Production is highly capital-intensive and relies on recycled scrap as input.

products.name: Fabricated Steel Products (Fabricated Rebar, Wire Mesh, Steel Fence Posts, Post-Tension Cable)
products.description: Steel products are further processed at fabrication facilities to create custom-shaped and assembled items such as fabricated rebar, welded wire mesh, steel fence posts, and post-tension cables, often tailored for specific construction projects. This involves shearing, bending, welding, and assembly, and may include installation services.

products.name: Construction Products Sales and Rental
products.description: Through dedicated operations, the company sells and rents construction-related products and equipment to concrete installers and other construction businesses. This is a distribution and service business supporting the construction industry.

products.name: Ground Stabilization Solutions (Geogrids and Geopier Foundation Systems)
products.description: Manufactures and sells polymer-based geogrids and engineered foundation systems for ground stabilization, soil reinforcement, and asphalt optimization in infrastructure and industrial construction. Delivery involves both product manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: High-Strength and Specialty Steel Products
products.description: Produces heat-treated, high-strength steel bars and plates for specialized applications such as truck trailers, energy markets, and military vehicles. Manufacturing involves advanced metallurgical processes and quality control.

products.name: Performance Reinforcing Steel (Galvabar, ChromX, CryoSteel, Anchoring Systems)
products.description: Offers innovative reinforcing steel products with enhanced properties (e.g., corrosion resistance, high strength, cryogenic performance) and custom anchoring systems for infrastructure and energy applications. These are manufactured using proprietary processes and coatings.

products.name: Prefabricated Modular Bridge Systems
products.description: Provides patented prefabricated and modular bridge components for rapid on-site installation, leveraging off-site manufacturing and licensing agreements. Delivery combines manufacturing and engineering services.

products.name: Modular Buildings
products.description: Manufacture of modular buildings for residential, commercial, and industrial markets, produced in climate-controlled factories and delivered to construction sites for assembly.

products.name: Structural Wall Panels and Engineered Wood Products
products.description: Production of structural wall panels, permanent wood foundations, and glue-laminated timber products for use in construction, manufactured in controlled environments and delivered to building sites.

products.name: Professional Building Products Retailing
products.description: Retail sale and distribution of professional building products, often in conjunction with manufactured wall panel deliveries, serving contractors and builders.

products.name: Recruitment and Talent Solutions Services
products.description: Provision of recruitment process outsourcing, contingent workforce solutions, recruitment consulting, contract staffing, and managed service provider services to multinational companies, delivered by specialized consultants across global regions.

products.name: Downhole Drilling Tools and Services
products.description: Manufacture and supply of specialized drilling tools and downhole equipment for directional drilling in oil and gas, mining, geothermal, and water well applications, with most products produced in-house and delivered to energy sector clients.

products.name: Real Estate and Investment Management
products.description: Holding and management of corporate-owned real estate assets and investments in a limited number of publicly traded and private companies, generating returns through asset appreciation and income.

products.name: Investment Research Subscriptions
products.description: Digital subscription-based investment research products covering a broad spectrum of asset classes and strategies, delivered via online platforms and periodic reports. Content is produced by experienced analysts and editors and is accessible on desktop, laptop, and mobile devices.

products.name: Financial Software and Analytical Tools
products.description: Digital software applications and analytical tools for self-directed investors, including portfolio management, stock screening, risk management, and algorithmic trading idea generation. Delivered as cloud-based platforms and applications, often integrated with research content.

products.name: Free Financial Education Content
products.description: Extensive library of free digital educational content and investment publications, accessible to subscribers via email and online platforms, designed to attract and nurture potential paid subscribers.

products.name: Members-Only Investing Conferences
products.description: Exclusive, members-only investing conferences where subscribers interact with editors and analysts and network with each other, delivered as in-person or virtual events.

products.name: Dry Van Trailers
products.description: Manufactured trailers with composite sandwich panel walls (DuraPlate® technology) for dry freight transport, produced in company facilities and distributed via direct and dealer channels.

products.name: Refrigerated Trailers
products.description: Thermally efficient, maximum payload trailers for temperature-controlled freight, built by third-party contract manufacturers and sold under the ArcticLite® trademark.

products.name: Platform Trailers
products.description: Flat or drop-deck trailers (steel, aluminum, or combination) for hauling large equipment and materials, manufactured in-house and distributed through dealers.

products.name: Tank Trailers
products.description: Stainless steel, aluminum, and fiberglass-reinforced poly tank trailers for transporting liquids in dairy, food, beverage, oil, gas, and chemical markets, manufactured in company facilities.

products.name: Truck Bodies (Dry Freight, Refrigerated, Platform, Cargo)
products.description: Truck-mounted bodies for dry freight, refrigerated, platform, and cargo applications, manufactured using DuraPlate® panels and other materials, with upfitting and customization options.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of replacement parts, maintenance, and repair services for trailers and truck bodies, delivered via service centers and a nationwide network.

products.name: Truck Body Upfitting Solutions
products.description: Customization and installation services for truck bodies, including mounting, shelving, partitions, thermal solutions, and repairs, provided through dedicated upfitting locations.

products.name: Process Systems (Engineered Products)
products.description: Manufacture of stainless steel storage tanks, silos, mixers, and processors for dairy, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical, craft brewing, and biotech industries.

products.name: Composites and Structural Panels
products.description: Production and sale of DuraPlate® composite panels and EcoNexTM technology for use in truck bodies, overhead doors, and industrial applications beyond trailers.

products.name: Trailer Aerodynamic Solutions
products.description: Aerodynamic add-ons such as DuraPlate® AeroSkirt® to improve trailer fuel economy, manufactured and sold as accessories for trailers.

products.name: Trailers as a Service (TaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based, on-demand trailer capacity service including equipment, maintenance, and digital cargo security, delivered via a digital platform.

products.name: Digital Marketplace for Equipment and Parts (Linq Venture Holdings LLC)
products.description: Digital platform for marketing and selling Wabash and non-Wabash equipment, parts, and services to end customers and dealers.

products.name: Parts Distribution Platform (Wabash Parts LLC)
products.description: Unified distribution network for aftermarket transportation parts, leveraging multiple distribution centers and dealer service capabilities for faster shipping and broader inventory.

products.name: Used Trailers Sales
products.description: Sale of used trailers through dedicated fleet sales centers and other channels, facilitating new trailer sales and serving wholesale markets.

products.name: Wood Products (Trailer Flooring)
products.description: Manufacture of laminated hardwood oak flooring primarily for use in dry van trailers, produced at company facilities.

products.name: Secure Networking Solutions
products.description: A suite of hardware and software products that converge networking and security, including network firewall appliances (FortiGate), secure ethernet switches (FortiSwitch), wireless access points (FortiAP), and 5G/LTE connectivity gateways (FortiExtender). These are delivered as physical, virtual, cloud, or SaaS solutions and require physical manufacturing and proprietary ASICs.

products.name: Unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) Solutions
products.description: A cloud-centric platform providing secure access for users and applications, integrating firewall, SD-WAN, secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, DLP, DEM, RBI, ZTNA, and cloud security. Delivered via global cloud infrastructure and supports deployment on-premises, in private data centers, or public clouds.

products.name: AI-Driven Security Operations (SecOps) Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of cybersecurity software and services for threat identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery, including SIEM, SOAR, XDR, threat intelligence, endpoint protection, and managed security services. Delivered as integrated software platforms and cloud services.

products.name: FortiGuard Security Subscription Services
products.description: A suite of AI-powered security subscription services providing application, content, device, NOC/SOC, and web security. Delivered as cloud-based or integrated services to enhance detection and enforcement across the attack surface.

products.name: Technical Support and Advanced Support Services (FortiCare)
products.description: Technical support services offering 24x7 global assistance, enhanced SLAs, and priority hardware replacement, with multiple service tiers (Elite, Premium, Essential) and advanced support options. Delivered by expert teams to ensure efficient operation and maintenance of Fortinet solutions.

products.name: Cybersecurity Training and Certification Programs
products.description: Training and certification programs for customers, partners, and employees, delivered through the Fortinet Training Institute and public/private partnerships. Programs are provided digitally and in-person to address cybersecurity skills shortages.

products.name: Operational Technology (OT) Security Solutions
products.description: Security solutions specifically designed for operational technology and cyber-physical systems, protecting critical infrastructure such as energy, utilities, manufacturing, and transportation. Delivered as integrated hardware, software, and security services.

products.name: Recorded Music
products.description: Production, marketing, distribution, sale, and licensing of sound recordings by signed artists, delivered via digital (streaming, downloads) and physical (CD, vinyl) formats globally. Involves physical manufacturing, digital distribution, and artist development.

products.name: Music Publishing
products.description: Acquisition, administration, and licensing of rights to musical compositions, generating revenue from uses such as performance, digital, mechanical, synchronization, and sheet music. Delivered through contracts with songwriters and third-party rights holders, and involves global royalty collection and licensing.

products.name: Artist Services (including Merchandising, Touring, Sponsorships, and Fan Engagement)
products.description: Provision of services and participation in artist-related activities beyond recorded music, such as merchandising, VIP ticketing, fan clubs, concert promotion, and sponsorships. Delivered through expanded-rights deals and specialized divisions, involving both physical and digital channels.

products.name: Distribution Services for Independent Labels and Artists
products.description: Marketing, distribution, and sales of music and video products for independent labels and artists to retail and wholesale distributors, both physically and digitally, through specialized distribution arms and international ventures.

products.name: Catalog Management and Exploitation
products.description: Repackaging, reissuing, and marketing of previously released or unreleased music and video titles from the company's extensive catalog, including box sets, compilations, and special releases. Delivered through dedicated catalog divisions and label activities.

products.name: Production Music
products.description: Creation, administration, and licensing of production music for use in media such as television, film, and advertising, delivered through a dedicated production music catalog and global publishing operations.

products.name: Chiropractic Care Services
products.description: Provision of routine, non-acute chiropractic adjustments and wellness care delivered by licensed chiropractors in retail clinic settings. Services are provided in-person, without appointments, using a cash-based, non-insurance model, and include customizable membership and wellness treatment plans.

products.name: Franchise Sales and Support
products.description: Sale of franchise licenses for chiropractic clinics, including ongoing support, training, and operational systems for franchisees and regional developers. Revenue is generated from initial franchise fees, ongoing royalties, and marketing fees.

products.name: Railroad Infrastructure Leasing
products.description: Leasing of railroad infrastructure and related real estate, specifically 112 miles of railroad property, to external customers such as Norfolk Southern Railway. This involves ownership and management of physical transportation infrastructure assets, generating revenue through long-term ground leases.

products.name: Solar Farm Land Leasing
products.description: Leasing of land for utility-scale solar power generation projects, including 447 acres supporting approximately 82 Megawatts of generating capacity. The company owns the land and leases it to solar operators, generating revenue through ground leases.

products.name: Greenhouse Real Estate Leasing and Sales (Controlled Environment Agriculture)
products.description: Leasing and sale of greenhouse properties (approximately 82 acres, 357,000 square feet) primarily for state-licensed cannabis and food cultivation. The company owns and manages these physical assets, generating revenue through leases and property sales to cultivation operators.

products.name: Seller Financing for Real Estate Transactions
products.description: Provision of seller financing (secured loans) to buyers of company-owned real estate properties, typically as part of property sales. This involves extending credit secured by the sold properties, generating interest income and facilitating transactions.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial and industrial loans, construction loans, and commercial real estate loans to businesses, primarily secured by business assets or real estate, delivered through in-person banking offices and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgage loans, including fixed and variable rate loans, home equity lines of credit, and jumbo mortgages, secured by real estate and delivered through branches and digital platforms, involving regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides direct and indirect consumer loans, including auto, motorcycle, recreational vehicle, unsecured loans, and personal lines of credit, originated through branches and approved dealerships, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equipment Financing and Leasing
products.description: Offers commercial and technology equipment leases and financing agreements nationwide to small, medium, and large businesses, delivered through subsidiaries and requiring underwriting, asset management, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Insurance Products and Services
products.description: Provides a full range of life, health, property and casualty insurance products, as well as third-party insurance administration services, delivered through licensed insurance agency subsidiaries and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Premium Financing
products.description: Offers loans to finance insurance premiums for property and casualty policies, originated through independent insurance agency partners nationwide, secured by unearned premiums, and managed through specialized lending offices.

products.name: Deposit and Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit) and cash management solutions for individuals, businesses, and municipalities, delivered through branches, ATMs, ITMs, and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Payment and Card Services
products.description: Offers debit and ATM cards, credit cards for individuals and businesses, merchant credit card transaction processing, and person-to-person and business-to-business payment processing via digital platforms, delivered through partnerships and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Trust, Fiduciary, and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provides custom-tailored fiduciary and trust services, asset management, and administration services, including employee benefit, retirement, and healthcare plan administration, delivered through specialized teams and requiring regulatory compliance and in-person expertise.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers investment brokerage services to customers through an unaffiliated registered broker-dealer located at Peoples Bank’s offices, requiring regulatory compliance and delivered in-person.

products.name: Safe Deposit and Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Provides safe deposit rental facilities, money orders, cashier’s checks, and related ancillary banking services through branch locations, requiring physical infrastructure and regulated processes.

products.name: PALSONIFY (paltusotine)
products.description: An FDA-approved, once-daily oral small molecule somatostatin receptor ligand (SST2 agonist) for the treatment of adults with acromegaly who had an inadequate response to surgery or for whom surgery is not an option. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral tablet, it is also in late-stage development for carcinoid syndrome associated with neuroendocrine tumors (NETs).

products.name: Atumelnant
products.description: An investigational, orally available, nonpeptide small molecule ACTH receptor antagonist for the treatment of diseases caused by excess ACTH, including congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) and ACTH-dependent Cushing’s syndrome (ADCS). Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral tablet, it is in late-stage clinical development for both adult and pediatric populations.

products.name: CRN09682 (Non-peptide Drug Conjugate for SST2 Positive Solid Tumors)
products.description: A first-in-class, non-peptide, non-radioactive drug conjugate linking an SST2 agonist with the cytotoxic drug MMAE for the treatment of SST2-expressing neuroendocrine tumors and other SST2-positive solid tumors. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and conjugation, it is administered to selectively deliver cytotoxic agents to tumor cells.

products.name: Pipeline of Nonpeptide GPCR-targeted Therapeutics for Endocrine Diseases and Tumors
products.description: A portfolio of internally discovered, orally available, nonpeptide small molecule drug candidates targeting peptide hormone GPCRs for a variety of endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors, including Graves’ disease, polycystic kidney disease, hyperparathyroidism, diabetes, obesity, and GPCR-targeted oncology indications. These are in preclinical or early clinical development and are manufactured via chemical synthesis.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and acquisition of first mortgage loans and senior participation interests in first mortgage loans secured by institutional-quality commercial properties. These loans are typically floating rate, require significant underwriting, and are delivered through direct lending and selective acquisitions.

products.name: Mezzanine and Subordinate Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination and acquisition of mezzanine loans and subordinate mortgage interests secured by commercial real estate, providing higher-yield, higher-risk debt financing. These are typically structured as part of the capital stack below senior mortgages and require specialized underwriting and structuring expertise.

products.name: Investment in Commercial Real Estate Securities
products.description: Investment in commercial real estate-related securities, including collateralized loan obligations (CRE CLOs), commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS), and secured real estate securities. These are financial instruments purchased in the secondary market and require financial capital and expertise in structured finance.

products.name: Ownership and Management of Real Estate Owned (REO) Properties
products.description: Ownership and management of commercial real estate properties acquired through foreclosure or deed-in-lieu, including office and multifamily properties. This involves direct property management and asset disposition activities.

products.name: Toncoin Staking and Treasury Management
products.description: The company acquires and manages large holdings of Toncoin, the native digital asset of the TON blockchain, and participates in staking activities to earn rewards. This involves digital asset management, staking through third-party custodians, and yield generation, all conducted digitally and governed by blockchain protocols.

products.name: Livestream Social Commerce Platform and Services
products.description: Through MARKET.live and LyveCom, the company provides a livestream shopping platform and AI-driven video commerce technology, offering brands and retailers tools for interactive, video-based social commerce, including content creation, influencer management, store setup, and omnichannel checkout. Services are delivered digitally via integrations with major social and video platforms.

products.name: Social Crowdfunding and Issuer Marketing Services
products.description: Go Fund Yourself is an interactive social crowdfunding platform and reality TV show that provides public and private companies with exposure for their Regulation CF and Regulation A offerings, generating revenue from issuer appearance fees, marketing, advertising, and content production. Services are delivered through a digital platform and televised programming.

products.name: Freight Railcar Manufacturing
products.description: Designs and manufactures a wide range of freight railcars, including covered hoppers, gondolas, boxcars, flat cars, tank cars, and intermodal railcars, in North America, Europe, and Brazil. Production involves large-scale physical manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: Automotive Railcar Equipment
products.description: Manufactures specialized railcar equipment for transporting light vehicles, including automobiles, SUVs, and trucks. Production requires custom engineering and physical manufacturing.

products.name: Sustainable Railcar Conversion Services
products.description: Provides services to repurpose and retrofit existing railcars for new uses, including rebodying, stretching, re-racking, and tank car retrofits. Delivered through engineering and physical modification at specialized facilities.

products.name: Railcar Component Parts Manufacturing and Reconditioning
products.description: Manufactures and reconditions railcar components such as cushioning units, couplers, yokes, side frames, bolsters, and bogies. Involves both new production and refurbishment at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Wheel Services
products.description: Operates a network of wheel shops providing wheel and axle reconditioning, machining, finishing, and downsizing for freight railcars. Delivered through specialized physical facilities.

products.name: Railcar Maintenance Services
products.description: Provides routine and specialized railcar maintenance, overhaul, and repair services for third parties and company-owned fleets, using certified maintenance shops.

products.name: Railcar Leasing
products.description: Owns and leases a fleet of railcars, offering flexible operating and per diem leases to customers. Leases may be for newly built or refurbished railcars and can be sold with attached leases to investors.

products.name: Fleet Management and Regulatory Compliance Services
products.description: Provides software and services for railcar maintenance management, accounting, logistics, tracking, administration, remarketing, and regulatory compliance. Delivered digitally and through professional services teams.

products.name: Engineering and Design Services
products.description: Comprehensive design services including electronic, mechanical, optical, and experience design, as well as industrialization engineering, product verification, and manufacturing test solution development. Delivered by specialized teams using advanced modeling, CAD tools, and testing systems, supporting products across all served markets.

products.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
products.description: High-volume, highly automated, continuous flow manufacturing and assembly of electronic products and components, including PCBAs, sub-systems, and complete systems, for a wide range of industries. Delivered through global production sites with advanced computerized control and monitoring systems.

products.name: Supply Chain Management Services
products.description: End-to-end supply chain management including procurement, inventory management, logistics, and electronic supply chain tools. Services leverage global procurement, AI-driven orchestration, and cloud-based platforms to optimize cost, inventory, and risk for customers.

products.name: Systems Assembly and Product Fulfillment Services
products.description: Assembly of complex systems and sub-systems, direct-order fulfillment, and configure-to-order services, including testing and quality assurance under various environmental conditions. Delivered at all manufacturing locations to reduce customer inventory and obsolescence risk.

products.name: Regulated Industries Manufacturing Solutions
products.description: Manufacturing and related services for regulated markets such as automotive and transportation, healthcare and packaging, and renewables and energy infrastructure. Involves compliance with industry-specific regulations and quality standards.

products.name: Intelligent Infrastructure Manufacturing Solutions
products.description: Manufacturing and design services for capital equipment, cloud and data center infrastructure, networking, communications, and AI infrastructure. Delivered through advanced manufacturing and engineering tailored to the digital ecosystem.

products.name: Connected Living and Digital Commerce Solutions
products.description: Manufacturing and automation solutions for connected living products, digital commerce, warehouse automation, and robotics. Includes design and assembly of smart consumer products and digital retail ecosystem devices.

products.name: Secure Facility Management Services
products.description: Provision of security, administrative, rehabilitation, education, and food services at secure correctional and detention facilities, including ownership, leasing, and management of maximum, medium, and minimum-security facilities. Services are delivered through in-person human labor and regulated infrastructure, often under long-term government contracts.

products.name: Reentry and Community-Based Services
products.description: Supervision and support of individuals in community-based programs and reentry centers, including temporary housing, programming, employment assistance, and other services to facilitate reintegration. Delivered through in-person staff at residential and day reporting centers, under government contracts.

products.name: Electronic Monitoring and Supervision Services
products.description: Comprehensive electronic monitoring and supervision services, including technology products such as radio frequency, GPS, and alcohol monitoring devices, as well as case management and supervision. Delivered digitally and through remote monitoring infrastructure, primarily for government agencies.

products.name: Facility Design, Construction, and Finance Services
products.description: Consultation, design, construction, and financing of new secure facilities and renovation of older facilities for government clients. Delivered through project management, in-house architectural staff, and subcontracted construction firms, often bundled with management contracts.

products.name: Secure Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of secure transportation and contract detention officer services for individuals in custody, including movement between facilities and courts. Delivered through specialized vehicles and trained personnel, under government contracts in the U.S. and U.K.

products.name: Skip Tracing Services
products.description: Enhanced location research, commercial data verification, and physical observation to verify and investigate address information for individuals on government non-detained dockets. Delivered through investigative staff and digital research tools, under government contracts.

products.name: Neuroplastogenic Therapeutics for Psychiatric and Neurological Disorders
products.description: Development and commercialization of next-generation, small-molecule neuroplastogenic drugs, including non-hallucinogenic psychedelic-inspired compounds, for the treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders such as depression, anxiety, and addiction. These are produced via proprietary drug discovery platforms and require extensive preclinical and clinical development, regulatory approval, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: Out-Licensing of Psychedelic-Inspired Molecules and Drug Portfolios
products.description: Licensing of proprietary psychedelic-inspired molecules and drug portfolios, such as those from the Psybrary™ platform and EVM201 portfolio, to third-party pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies for further development and commercialization. This involves intellectual property management and contractual agreements rather than direct manufacturing or clinical development.

products.name: Cannabinoid-Based Therapeutics and Formulations
products.description: Development and licensing of cannabinoid-based drug formulations, including topical creams for radiation dermatitis and cannabinoid conjugates with COX-2 inhibitors or steroids for pain and joint disease. These products are developed through pharmaceutical synthesis and are licensed to third parties for commercialization.
